description: Land Title Settlement Department - Saddhatissapura New Town, Lunugamwehera D/S Division, Hambantota District - Cad. Map No. 830061
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains a formal declaration by the Commissioner General of Land Title Settlement determining title to specific land parcels (Parcel Nos. 6, 25, 28, 32, 38, 44 and 91) in Hambantota District, including details of ownership, extent, class of title, and encumbrances. The content falls squarely within the Land Gazettes category as it concerns land registration, title determination, and property ownership matters.
